quotes.text: Synthetic Hospital is built entirely from publicly available medical-education material containing no protected health information.
The released data files are fully synthetic and redistributable; the source material the pipeline was built from is not included.

parsed.rationale: Origin (public medical-education material), the generation method, and redistribution terms for the released data are stated. No licence or terms for the source decks and no consent or IRB status (or an explicit 'not required') is stated, so level 2 is not reached.
